Cegenydanyad Jewish Cemetery Two

Jewish Cemetery · Cégénydányád, Hungary

Not demolished. One of two Jewish cemeteries in Cégénydányád, both appearing on an 1896 cadastral map; this one's oldest tombstone dates to 1856, its newest to 1886. Population fell from 61 (of 760 residents) in 1880 to just 38 by 1920, recovering slightly to 52 by 1941. By April 1944, the community relied on occasional donations to fund its prayer house's repairs, paying church tax (311 Pengő in 1943) to Fehérgyarmat's jurisdiction; poorer members paid no tax and received community support instead. On May 31, 1944, residents were transported from Mátészalka to death camps; the local prayer house was later demolished.
